summary: Owner linked a public .Ysf (CPS file) CSV converter; read as text: frequency, tone, DCS 0x2800+octal, flag bits and 10-byte names agree with the static REA; it names byte 13 bits 2-3 "Special DCS". Owner installed the clean GMRS CPS; Windows Defender caught the infected dual-band file. Radio arrives 2026-11-28.
